## Problem

`E2E / Full Regression` on `main` (run [40801551641](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/40801551641), SHA `1f58bec37`) failed only in the canonical fixture screenshot suites after the #2581 release brought the 96-column terminal configuration (from staging #2557) to `main`:

- `fixture-visual`: 3 failed
- `fixture-visual-app`: 7 failed
- `fixture-visual-web-compact`: 1 failed

The baselines were captured with the previous 80-column rendering; the release changes the terminal grid/font fit, so every terminal-bearing fixture screenshot drifts by a small ratio (e.g. app-terminal: 3779 px, 0.02). The #2591 verifier fix is what allowed the Full suite to execute at all, which is why the stale baselines surfaced now.

## Expected behavior

The canonical visual baselines match the shipped 96-column rendering, the pinned `baseline_png_blobs` manifest agrees with the PNG bytes, and the three visual suites pass at the exact PR head.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 Regenerate the canonical visual baselines with `--update-snapshots=all` on the release rendering, update `e2e/tests/browser/migration-parity.json` blob hashes, and prove `fixture-visual`, `fixture-visual-app` and `fixture-visual-web-compact` pass at the PR head.

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
```

## Acceptance Report

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| SC-01 | Pending | Awaiting PR-head visual suite execution |

## E2E Verification

### New
- none: this restores the existing canonical baselines; no new browser behavior.

### Regression
- fixture-visual
- fixture-visual-app
- fixture-visual-web-compact
